approach: Static recompilation of the PPU code and the SPU jobs with ps3recomp, HLE system libraries, Direct3D 12 RSX backend
notes: Work in progress: 0.1.0 and 0.2.0 are pre-releases, and the first full release will be 1.0.0. Needs your own copy of the game; no game data is stored in this repository. As of the notes (2026-10-27) the game lifts and builds on Windows (Direct3D 12, 1280x720) and runs through the opening movie, the title screen and the menus; fights run at about 29 frames per second on the maps that were tested, with sound. Online and Cross-Save upload need PSN and do nothing. Developed with AI agent assistance under the maintainers' direction.
